title: Margherita Pizza

extendedIngredients.name: plain flour
extendedIngredients.original: 500 g plain flour, plus extra for kneading

extendedIngredients.name: whole peeled tomatoes
extendedIngredients.original: 1 x 400 g can whole peeled tomatoes

steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and 1 teaspoon of salt in a large bowl. Add 320 ml of lukewarm water and 1 tablespoon of olive oil, then stir to a shaggy dough.
Knead on a lightly floured bench for 5-8 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky. Return to the bowl, cover and leave in a warm spot for 60-90 minutes, until doubled in size.
Meanwhile, blend the whole peeled tomatoes with the garlic, 1 tablespoon of olive oil and half a teaspoon of salt until smooth. Set the sauce aside - no cooking needed.
Half an hour before baking, crank the oven to its highest setting (250 C or more) with a pizza stone or a sturdy upside-down oven tray on the middle shelf.
Punch down the dough, divide it into 2 balls and rest, covered, for 20 minutes. Pat the mozzarella dry with paper towel and tear it into chunks.
Dust a sheet of baking paper or a pizza peel with semolina. Stretch one ball into a 30 cm round, leaving the rim a little thicker.

Spread half the sauce thinly over the base, keeping a 2-3 cm border, and scatter over half the mozzarella. Slide onto the hot stone or tray and bake for 8-10 minutes, until the crust is browned and the cheese is blistered.
Repeat with the second ball of dough and the remaining sauce and mozzarella.
Rest each pizza for a minute, then top with the basil leaves, a drizzle of olive oil and a grind of black pepper. Slice and serve.
